notes.title: Will you let the moon stay red ?!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41470024/9e6cbce70eb794f6bb1403c6faf0d5d9f9bf6979.png

Soviet moon base are heavily guarded by special space unit "Cosmos Spetsnaz" They are equipped with the newest space weapons and space battle suits.


Use variety of weapons to get rid of commies
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41470024/574009c16f8432afe9c2ed5b8712057c5d415532.png

Main weapons used by moon base garison

ASC 67 - Assault Space Carabine 
Special version of well known soviet assault rifle

SP 70 - Space Pistol 
Standard weapons for officers and technical personnel of the moon base

Kirov's Gatling - experimental heavy weapons designed for heavy armored units

More weapons will be presented soon !  
 Assault shotgun,  Flamethrower,  Grenade and rocket launchers,  Gauss rifles and more  


Guess who's back... 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41470024/f734e2022239310d6f8a2b84422361284d390f39.gif
Discover secrets of soviet moon science facility !


Development Status

Playable Intro  - 80% done
Moon base sector 1 - 75% done

Most of core gameplay mechanics are working
Curently we are working on new enemies animations and AI behaviors
Next in line is a bunch of finishers, melee combat and logic puzzles.   

Stay updated and don't forget to 
Follow and add to wishlist !
